proof_summary: The proof relates successive prime-power binomial coefficients through the unit products \(P_t=\prod_{1\le u\le p^r,\,p\nmid u}(u+t p^r)\), whose first and second finite differences gain high \(p\)-adic divisibility by pairing \(u\) with \(p^r-u\) and exploiting vanishing reciprocal-power sums over the units. Prime-power stability of the lower-level binomial coefficients then makes the leading terms cancel, with direct finite modular calculations handling the boundary cases \((p,r)=(3,2)\) and \((5,2)\).
